chunks: When Our verses are recited before him, he turns away haughtily as though he did not hear them, as if there were deafness in his ears. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: How does a disbeliever react when Quran verses are recited to him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual deafness (waqran) of the arrogant, where physical hearing fails to translate into cognitive acceptance due to pride. It serves as a diagnostic sign of the disbeliever's internal state, linking their outward rejection to an impending painful punishment, a theme frequently cited by Imams to illustrate the consequences of ignoring divine guidance.
